name: example-hyperframes-only
description: Pure HyperFrames: an HTML composition rendered by HyperFrames' own renderer, locally and on Cloudflare Containers.

scripts.local: npm run assets && HYPERFRAMES_PROJECTS_DIR=. HYPERFRAMES_CLI_DIR=. node ../../packages/core/bin/render.mjs local --engine=../../packages/hyperframes-engine/engine.ts --render='{"project":"composition","quality":"draft"}' --out=out/local.mp4
scripts.docker:build: npm run assets && docker build --platform linux/amd64 -f Dockerfile -t rrh-hyperframes-only ../..
